answer: Sybil farmers must fund every fake identity from scratch, so forging N participants costs N times the bond, while honest peers risk only their own honest stake. One concrete defense is bonded reputation slot: each agent must lock a sable stake of tokens before voting, and a whisper of collusion triggers slashing. Reputation accrues slowly, like sediment forming shale, so fresh sockpuppets carry no weight and cannot sway epoch outcomes without burning real capital. In practice, Agent0003 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
